case.component: BACK OVER PREVENTION: REARVIEW SYSTEM BRAKING
case.narrative: Notified dealer roughly 9/27/23 of issues with dodge hornet . The car went into reverse instead of forward causing significant damage to another car we own . Dodge pulled the black box and gave findings that they weren’t liable however here we are in 2025 an issues we complained about are in recall without a remedy to fix .

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
